title: San Francisco homes that lost money in years they paid related companies more than the loss, 2015 to 2025
question: Over every report year now on file, which San Francisco homes reported a loss while paying related parties more than the loss?
finding: 25 home-years: California Convalescent Hospital 2017 (loss $101,536, paid $144,092); Central Gardens 2015 (loss $599,304, paid $617,971); Central Gardens 2016 (loss $3,486, paid $392,371); Central Gardens 2017 (loss $108,180, paid $317,371); Central Gardens 2018 (loss $399,491, paid $694,912); City View Post Acute 2020 (loss $2.2 million, paid $5.1 million); City View Post Acute 2021 (loss $3.2 million, paid $4.9 million); City View Post Acute 2022 (loss $4.3 million, paid $5.3 million); City View Post Acute 2023 (loss $1.6 million, paid $3.2 million); Kindred Nursing & Rehabilitation Nineteenth Avenue 2017 (loss $1.0 million, paid $1.6 million); Kindred Transitional Care & Rehabilitation-Tunnell Center 2015 (loss $1.8 million, paid $6.2 million); Kindred Transitional Care and Rehabilitation-Lawton 2015 (loss $153,459, paid $3.9 million); Kindred Transitional Care and Rehabilitation-Tunnell Center 2016 (loss $889,836, paid $4.7 million); Lawton Skilled Nursing and Rehabilitation Center 2017 (loss $2.8 million, paid $3.8 million); Lawton Skilled Nursing and Rehabilitation Center 2018 (loss $644,087, paid $1.5 million); Lawton Skilled Nursing and Rehabilitation Center 2019 (loss $312,852, paid $1.5 million); Lawton Skilled Nursing and Rehabilitation Center 2020 (loss $78,423, paid $2.2 million); San Francisco Health Care 2016 (loss $1.6 million, paid $5.2 million); San Francisco Health Care & Rehab 2024 (loss $653,754, paid $1.8 million); Sequoias San Francisco Convalescent Hospital 2015 (loss $1.3 million, paid $2.1 million); Sequoias San Francisco Convalescent Hospital 2016 (loss $74,138, paid $2.2 million); Sequoias San Francisco Convalescent Hospital 2020 (loss $1.1 million, paid $2.4 million); Sheffield Convalescent Hospital 2015 (loss $324, paid $87,586); The Sequoias San Francisco 2025 (loss $148,430, paid $3.4 million); Tunnell Skilled Nursing and Rehabilitation Center 2019 (loss $1.6 million, paid $2.8 million).
how: Home-years with net income below zero and positive related-party transactions larger than the loss, all years 2015 to 2025.
limits: A loss beside related payments is not evidence that the payments caused it: rent under a master lease, occupancy, a change of operator and one-off costs all produce losses. 2023 to 2025 are unaudited.
